phase_prompt.label: The Silent Watchers
phase_prompt.summary: The vast host of regulator entities stands motionless around the House of Fire, a barrier of dark glass and cold light protecting the system core.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Photorealistic cinematic shot. An endless ocean of stationary, obsidian-skinned humanoid entities filling the frame, their faces illuminated by the warm orange glow of a massive fire off-camera. They wear robes of flowing liquid data glass. Their backs feature heat-shimmering wings made of vertical light rays. The atmosphere is thick, dark, and heavy. ISO 100, 85mm lens, focus on the texture of the nearest entity's shoulder, background falling into soft blur. Blue Geez glyphs scroll faintly across their chests.
